question.text: What percentage of companies globally will fulfill their pre-2026 broiler commitments in 2026 and 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the percentage of global companies reporting in 2026 or 2027 that they have fulfilled the broiler commitments they made before 2026 according to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker) when accessed by Metaculus on January 1, 2028.
question.fine_print:
Specifically, the denominator will be obtained by selecting the "Broiler" issue on the [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) progress tracker, a "Victory Date" of 1990 to 2025, and a "Timeline" of 2026 and after. The numerator will then be obtained by *additionally* selecting the "Reporting Fulfilled" status.

If Chicken Watch ceases reporting or significantly changes its criteria such that previous reporting is not comparable, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I couldn't read the current resolution figure. Chicken Watch's tracker loads its data from a third-party database that my tools can't query, so I don't know today's percentage. The closest data point is a February 2026 Faunalytics analysis: 6% of broiler commitments due in 2025 or earlier were fulfilled. Commitments due in 2026 or later, which is what this question counts, are probably lower so far, but that is unconfirmed.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-19: The tracker page at chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker loads but shows no figures. The data sits in an embedded "Awesome Table" view (ID -NqYH6wXir1Ia4I27P6G) that pulls from a Firebase database. Neither the page source, the view page nor the site's scripts expose a CSV or JSON file I could read. [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Broiler)
- I could not get either count the question uses: all broiler commitments made 1990-2025 with deadlines of 2026 or later, and how many of those are "Reporting Fulfilled". The forecaster should open the tracker in a browser and apply the filters directly.
- The question's range runs from 0.86% to 14.9%. If Metaculus centred that range on the live value, the current figure may be in the low single digits. That is my guess, not something I verified.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The count is cumulative to 2028-01-01, so companies that report fulfilling a 2026 deadline in 2027 will raise the numerator.
- 2026-02 (Faunalytics, citing Chicken Watch): [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
  - 6% of global broiler commitments due in 2025 or earlier were fulfilled.
  - About 4.5% of those due in 2024 or earlier were fulfilled.
  - 76% of commitments due in 2025 or earlier had never reported any progress.
  - Fulfilment was 35% in Europe and 1% in North America.
  - Over 350 company broiler commitments fall due in 2026.
- For comparison, 64% of cage-free egg commitments due by 2025 were fulfilled. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026 (exact date unclear): Mercy For Animals' Serving Up Change report rated 27 North American foodservice providers. 7 had reported progress and 10 had published roadmaps. Several named firms had reported nothing. [Serving Up Change](https://servingupchange.org/)
- 2026-03: Compassion in World Farming's European ChickenTrack 2025 report: [Retail Insight Network](https://www.retail-insight-network.com/news/european-hotels-and-retailers-advance-on-chicken-welfare-commitments/), [FDBusiness](https://www.fdbusiness.com/chickentrack-2025-shows-steady-progress-on-broiler-welfare-but-calls-for-continued-industry-commitment/)
  - 76 of 107 companies reported progress, up from 64 of 93 the year before.
  - Only Waitrose and REMA 1000 Norge were fully compliant ahead of 2026.
  - About 18 UK brands withdrew their pledges, mainly because switching to slower-growing breeds was hard. Withdrawals could shrink the denominator if Chicken Watch removes them.
  - In the 2025 edition, 36 companies reported under 10% progress on breed change and 17 reported none.
- 2025 (exact date unclear): KFC UK said it would not meet its 2026 commitment, and UK food businesses were described as "unlikely" to meet the 2026 deadline. [The Grocer](https://www.thegrocer.co.uk/news/uk-food-businesses-unlikely-to-meet-2026-chicken-welfare-deadline/702371.article), [Poultry News](https://www.poultrynews.co.uk/production/where-now-for-the-better-chicken-committment.html)
- 2024: In North America, 22% of signatories were reporting progress. Only Campfire Treats and Evermore Pet Food were fully compliant. [CIWF](https://www.ciwf.com/media-and-news/news/2024/03/more-us-food-companies-share-progress-towards-adopting-higher-welfare-chicken)

## 4. Base rates
- The fulfilment rate for older deadlines rose from about 4.5% (due by 2024) to 6% (due by 2025) as of February 2026, roughly 1.5 points per extra deadline year. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- Reporting progress is not the same as fulfilling: U.S. progress reporting was 18% in 2022 and 22% in 2024. [CIWF 2022](https://www.ciwf.com/media/7453487/chickentrack-2022.pdf)
- Most commitments to be counted here fall due in 2026, and fulfilment reports usually come in annual reports or ChickenTrack submissions several months after the deadline year. A rise is therefore most likely in early-to-mid 2027.
- Seasonality: ChickenTrack reports come out around March each year, so updates tend to bunch then. I found no year-by-year Chicken Watch values to compare November with December.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Metaculus community prediction, Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question.
- None of the markets your code collected match (chicken wing prices, Arkansas broiler output and others).
- An older question list asks "What percentage of companies will fulfill their 2026 BCC commitments?" using the same tracker, but gives no values. [Google Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1U--UadjSOim6ntP2ltlTWQXdwtSpkNJ9swzzfFxf3oY/edit)
- 2024 (Rethink Priorities): Founders Pledge assumed a 30% chance that companies follow through on broiler pledges. [Rethink Priorities](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/will-companies-meet-their-animal-welfare-commitments/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The end of 2026, when the 2026 deadline passes.
- Company annual and ESG reports in early 2027.
- CIWF's U.S. and European ChickenTrack reports, around March 2027.
- Possible further pledge withdrawals, or Chicken Watch reclassifying commitments, which could move the denominator.
- The resolution check by Metaculus on 2028-01-01.
- Weather is not relevant to this question.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-03-13: CIWF's European ChickenTrack 2025 covers 107 of more than 410 European BCC signatories:
  - 76 reported progress, up from 64; 31 did not report.
  - Waitrose went from 14% to 100% on breed transition, and REMA 1000 Norge reached full compliance before the deadline.
  - 36 companies report under 10% breed-transition progress and 17 report none.
  - Only 8 to 10 companies are fully compliant on any single criterion.
  [Retail Insight Network](https://www.retail-insight-network.com/newsletters/european-hotels-and-retailers-advance-on-chicken-welfare-commitments)
- 2026-03-04: Eighteen UK brands dropped the BCC for an industry-led scheme without the slower-growing-breed requirement. Reports name KFC, Burger King, Nando's, Popeyes, Wingstop, Wagamama, The Big Table and The Restaurant Group. It is unclear whether Chicken Watch removes these commitments (smaller denominator) or keeps them as unfulfilled. [World Animal Protection](https://www.worldanimalprotection.org.uk/latest/blogs/better-chicken-commitment-dropped/), [FarmingUK](https://www.farminguk.com/news/fast-growing-breed-row-erupts-after-firms-quit-better-chicken-commitment_68043.html)
- Undated, 2026: An Albert Schweitzer Foundation document says many companies pushed their 2026 deadlines back to 2030. [ASF](https://albert-schweitzer-stiftung.de/track/uploads/mhi_-_higher-welfare-broiler-supply.pdf)
- 2026-06: Whitsons (US food service) reports 100% for 2026 on some BCC criteria (auditing, stocking density, enrichment). This is an example of a company that could report fulfillment. [Whitsons](https://whitsons.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Whitsons-Animal-Welfare-Update-2026.pdf)
- I found no BCC news dated October or November 2026.

## 4. Base rates
- About 4.5% of global broiler commitments due by 2024 had been fulfilled as of February 2026. Adding the 2025 deadlines raised this to about 6%, a gain of only 1.5 points even after the deadlines passed. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- Cage-free commitments for comparison: 93% fulfilled for deadlines by 2024, 64% for deadlines by 2025. Broiler fulfillment runs roughly 10 to 15 times lower. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- An undated EA Forum post says Chicken Watch listed 1,672 commitments, 1,007 due between 2020 and 2026. This is probably out of date. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/oRFgCTNKZirQyFzPT/corporate-commitments-breakdown)
- Seasonality: reporting tends to cluster around the spring ChickenTrack releases (EU in March, US around March) and companies' annual reports. I could not find year-by-year November-to-January values for this filter.
- The denominator for this question (commitments due 2026 or later) includes many deadlines that are still in the future, such as 2030. That probably pulls the fulfilled share below the 6% figure for past-due commitments. This is my inference, not a sourced figure.

## 5. Other forecasts
- One search result summarised a Metaculus question with this exact wording: median 11.8% (range 7.74 to 17.6), 17 forecasters, date unknown. A parallel cage-free question showed 4.43% (1.97 to 7.88). I couldn't open Metaculus (HTTP 403), so I haven't verified these numbers. [Metaculus feed](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/?search=cat%3Aseries--animal-welfare--animal-welfare--prediction-party)
- A planning spreadsheet behind this question series gives the filter recipe but no values. [Google Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1U--UadjSOim6ntP2ltlTWQXdwtSpkNJ9swzzfFxf3oY/edit)
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets supplied match this question. They cover chicken prices, broiler production, corporate taxes and similar topics.

## 6. Upcoming events
- 2026-12-31: The original BCC deadline for most commitments. Year-end and early-2027 corporate welfare reports may report fulfillment.
- About March 2027: CIWF's European ChickenTrack 2026 and US ChickenTrack reports. In past years these releases drove Chicken Watch status updates.
- Throughout 2027: possible further withdrawals or deadline extensions to 2030, and possible changes to how Chicken Watch records withdrawn commitments. A major criteria change would annul the question.
- 2028-01-01: Metaculus reads the tracker.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The text says Chicken Watch is checked on January 1, 2028, which is about 13.5 months away. The metadata, however, says resolution is around 2026-12-31. I weight the 2028 reading more heavily but allow for the earlier date, which would mean a lower value.

(b) **Latest known value:** I could not read the tracker directly. The question's bounds give a clue: 0.98522% is exactly 2/203 and 14.778% is exactly 30/203. That suggests that when the question was created, the tracker showed 2 "Reporting Fulfilled" out of about 203 qualifying commitments, roughly 1%. The closest related figure is from February 2026 (Faunalytics): 6% of broiler commitments due by 2025 had been fulfilled. That is a different, older-deadline group of commitments.

(c) **If nothing changed:** About 1% to 2%.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** Fulfilment of older deadlines rose only about 1.5 points per extra deadline year, and it stays near 4-6% even years after the deadlines.
- Most of this group has 2026 deadlines.
- European companies, which fulfil far more often (35% versus 1% in North America), may report compliance in the March 2027 ChickenTrack reports and in annual reports.
- A trend reading for January 2028 is about 3% to 6%.

(e) **Historical variation:** The rate moves slowly, typically 1-2 points per year. Chicken Watch logs updates with a lag, and many companies never report at all (76% had never reported progress).

(f) **Experts and markets:** No markets match this question.
- The question creator's "likely not higher" bound is about 14.8%.
- Industry press says UK and European firms are unlikely to meet the 2026 deadline.
- KFC UK has said it will miss.
- About 18 UK brands have withdrawn their pledges.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Chicken Watch barely updates the tracker, or adds many old commitments to the denominator, so the value stays near 1%.
- **High:** A batch of European companies reports full compliance in 2027 and Chicken Watch removes withdrawn pledges from the denominator, pushing the value toward 12-16%.

(e) **Historical variation.** Fulfilment for older deadlines rose only about 1.5 percentage points per additional deadline year. The broiler welfare transition is slow, and 76% of commitments have never reported any progress.

(f) **Experts and markets.**

- CIWF and The Grocer say most UK and European companies are unlikely to meet the 2026 deadline, and KFC UK says it won't.
- In North America, fulfilment is about 1%.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios.**
